c4f1da693af6b0106ffedb87215e9996f229b02b.summary: CrowdStrike blog on USB removable-media risk. It describes MUSTANG PANDA's USBFect worm campaigns (2023 to 2025, covering the Philippines, Taiwan and North America), late 2025 USB campaigns that dropped CoinMiner, and a 2025 US defense insider case involving more than 3,600 files. It closes by promoting CrowdStrike Falcon Data Protection and Device Control.
